understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to solve each level of the KA59 puzzle by moving the available/selectable pieces so that every goal tile marked with a '+' is occupied by a selectable piece at the same time; achieving this condition triggers WIN for the level, and completing all levels wins the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: A piece must be selected, then actions move the selected piece. CLICK attempts to move the selected piece to the clicked grid position (typically along a straight unobstructed route); if the route is blocked by walls/obstacles or the click has no valid movement effect, the piece does not move. Directional moves (e.g., MOVE_RIGHT) move the selected piece in that direction until it hits an obstacle/limit (appearing as a slide). Pieces cannot pass through walls/blocked tiles; movement is constrained by obstacles, and selection determines which piece responds to actions.
